def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    A = int(data[0])
    B = int(data[1])
    
    # We will create a grid of size (A+B) x (A+B)
    h = A + B
    w = A + B
    
    print(h, w)
    
    # Create the grid
    grid = [['.' for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    
    # Place A white components
    for i in range(A):
        grid[i][i] = '.'
    
    # Place B black components
    for i in range(B):
        grid[A + i][A + i] = '#'
    
    # Print the grid
    for row in grid:
        print(''.join(row))

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    A = int(data[0])
    B = int(data[1])
    
    # We will create a grid of size max(A, B) x max(A, B)
    h = max(A, B)
    w = max(A, B)
    
    print(h, w)
    
    # Create the grid
    grid = [['.' for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    
    # Place A white components
    for i in range(A):
        grid[i // w][i % w] = '.'
    
    # Place B black components
    for i in range(B):
        grid[h - 1 - (i // w)][w - 1 - (i % w)] = '#'
    
    # Print the grid
    for row in grid:
        print(''.join(row))
